definitions.full: H7332. razon I. רָזוֺן noun [masculine] leanness, wasting, scantness ; — absolute ׳ר : 1 leanness Isa 10:16 (figurative; opposed to מִשְׁמַנָּיו ). 2 wasting , i.e. wasting disease, Psa 106:15 (compare Bae). 3 ר ׳אֵיפַת Micah 6:10 ephah of scantness , scant measure. — II. רָזוֺן see רזן . below רזח (? cry out , compare Talmud מְרֻזָּח bewailed ).
